evidence.why: Shows signed increment initialization and helper-before-addition ordering.
The shared helper overwrites X and Y velocity from animation displacement each update.

facts.rationale: The shared helper's assignments materially clarify the meaning of the local += operation and prevent an incorrect cumulative-acceleration interpretation.
facts.value: Shared by active states 0, 1 and 2. Each physics update first calls it_8027A344, which assigns horizontal velocity from pokemon_spawn.x4.z times facing_dir and vertical velocity from pokemon_spawn.x4.y. It then adds tosakinto.x64_vel_x to the freshly assigned horizontal velocity. The stored signed value is therefore a bias to animation-derived velocity, not acceleration accumulated across successive ticks. Active entry chooses its sign; this callback has no local timer, collision test or state transition.

evidence.why: Explicit >=3-to-zero normalization and random sign selection.
State-3 entry, falling physics and fixed-false collision callback.
Continuation requires contact and validation guards.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's absolute claim that landing returns without resetting the cycling index, while preserving conditional collision routing and reachable state-cycle behavior.
facts.value: Runs in motion state 3, whose table entry has animation ID -1 and no animation callback and whose physics delegates configured falling motion. It supplies it_802C90E8 to common collision processing. Only a contact passing the helper's validation invokes that continuation. Active entry reuses stored x60_msid values below 3 and resets values >=3 to zero, then selects the resulting state and randomizes the horizontal increment's sign. It does not unconditionally reset the cycle, but a stored value of 3 does wrap to zero on landing. No negative-index guard is present. Without qualifying contact this callback requests no transition; it always returns false.

evidence.why: The wrapper calls the helper and returns a fixed false result.
Void signature, persistent scale/phase mutations and exact phase branches.

facts.rationale: Corrects the erroneous claim that the wrapper discards the helper's side effects. Unlike the appearance physics helper, this helper returns void.
facts.value: Forwards the Tosakinto Item_GObj to the void helper it_80279FF8 and then independently returns false. The helper reads pokemon_spawn.x5C; in phase 0 it uses pokemon_spawn.x48, current root-model scale and ItemAttr.x60_scale to grow or clamp the model scale and advance the phase to 1. Phase 2 performs no further work; other nonzero phases delegate to it_80279E24. These model and phase side effects persist; the wrapper neither discards nor reverses them.
